coverage: Sixteen original API cases, all declared catalog methods successful. Definition/learner/permission/scoring/persistence assertions are in exact source. 321 HTTP observations.
Seven original API cases, all methods successful. Two catalog investigations remain policy clarifications, not newly confirmed app failures. 344 HTTP observations.

execution.scope: Actual frontend lesson PATCH client through an isolated request recorder; JSON wire serialization, no network/browser/session.
execution.assertions: ARTICLE/VIDEO populated vs omitted content: canonical path, title, type and credential option retained; present content survives title edits; undefined body fields are omitted from JSON.

frontend_inspection: Editor updateLesson and useLessonAutosave spread the existing lesson before changing fields/sending. API helper always includes type and forwards current body/URL; undefined fields are dropped from JSON. Four actual-helper request-recorder matrices validate this boundary, without network. Reconciliation is not proof of deployed browser persistence or timing.

QUIZ-001.assertions: Creator/Admin create a three-type definition with out-of-input-order positions. Ordered questions/options, stable IDs and author correctness round-trip. Replacement retains two existing questions/IDs and adds one new question, preserving parent quiz ID; omitted question/options are removed from persistence. Reads create no attempts.

QUIZ-002.assertions: Creator/Admin get 404 for QUIZ lesson without definition; ARTICLE/VIDEO quiz PUT returns 400 without changing lesson type or creating a definition.

QUIZ-003.assertions: Creator/Admin mismatched existing quiz ID returns 400 with id validation and unchanged definition. Invalid question/option ID strings receive fresh valid UUIDs and persist. Authorized DELETE returns 204; GET becomes 404, lesson remains QUIZ and a separate unrelated definition is unchanged.

QUIZ-004.assertions: Creator/Admin ×16 invalid draft variants: empty/null/missing questions; empty/blank/null title; zero/negative/null points; zero/one/null options; blank/null option text; passing score -1/101. Every PUT returns 400 with a validation map and retains the exact previous definition; no attempt is created.

QUIZ-005.assertions: Creator/Admin single-choice definitions reject zero/two correct options with field-keyed 400; exactly one correct succeeds and author GET matches.

QUIZ-006.assertions: Creator/Admin multi-choice rejects zero correct options; one/two correct variants save and author GET verifies the exact correctness count.

QUIZ-007.assertions: Creator/Admin true/false rejects one/three options, duplicate labels, invalid label and zero/two correct options. Trimmed mixed-case True/False labels with one correct option save and read back.

QUIZ-008.assertions: Guest 401, entitled User 403 and entitled nonowner Creator 403 for author GET/PUT/DELETE with otherwise valid payload and matching CSRF. Definition remains unchanged. Owner/Admin author writes, reads and deletes succeed; learner grants do not grant author access. No attempt is created.

QUIZ-009.assertions: Entitled User, owner and Admin each read play twice. The exact author definition minus every isCorrect field is returned; explanations and shuffle flag remain, IDs/order are stable and no read attempt is created. Author correctness remains available only through authorized author GET.

QUIZ-010.assertions: Guest play/valid-CSRF submit return 401; User without grant and revoked User both return 403. No rejected attempt persists. Owner/Admin without grants play and submit successfully, scoring correctly through the supported bypass.

QUIZ-011.assertions: Entitled User/owner/Admin × single/true-false × correct/incorrect selections:12 submissions. Exact correct choice earns 5/5 and 100%; wrong choice earns 0/5 and 0%. Lesson/quiz/question IDs, pass flag, threshold, per-question correctness/points and explanation match.

QUIZ-012.assertions: Entitled User/owner/Admin × all correct/one correct/all correct plus incorrect/duplicate correct IDs:12 submissions. Only exact correct set and its duplicate-ID form earn points; subset/superset receive zero. Persisted answer sets are deduplicated and match the submitted semantic sets; no extra credit.

QUIZ-013.assertions: Entitled User/owner/Admin × thresholds 0/100/null cover empty, omitted and null answer lists, one-of-three and all-correct submissions. Unanswered questions score zero, null threshold passes irrespective of score, and threshold equality passes. 33.3/66.7 rounding is verified; exact 6.25% rounds to 6.3% HALF_UP. Feedback count and score identity/threshold fields match.

QUIZ-014.assertions: Entitled User/owner/Admin ×10 malformed sets: unknown/malformed/blank question, unknown/malformed/null option, option from another question, duplicate question answer and multiple selections for single/true-false. Each returns 400 with validation errors, persists zero attempts and retains exact quiz definition.

QUIZ-015.assertions: Identical valid User submissions return identical supported score responses but persist two distinct attempt UUIDs. Database fields verify actual user, lesson, quiz, timestamps, possible/achieved points, percentage, pass state and normalized answers. Supported Product/Library reloads retain access and attempt count. Current controller has no attempt-history/idempotency endpoint; no browser completion/history feature is inferred.

QUIZ-017.assertions: Exact catalog minimum payload saves under Creator, returns valid stable quiz/question/option IDs, author GET matches and learner play omits correctness while preserving IDs/false shuffle. Entitled User submits returned question/A IDs and scores 5/5,100%,passed; one attempt persists.

CONTENT-008.assertions: Creator/Admin create rejects blank/empty/missing title/type and unsupported enum with 400, preserving full Product. Null create position defaults to count+1; negative/duplicate positions persist. PATCH blank/unsupported type rejects without mutation; empty title and negative/duplicate positions save, null position preserves existing value. Actual API boundaries fully measured; intended PATCH/title/position validation consistency needs a product decision.

CONTENT-010.assertions: Creator/Admin Quiz→Article→Video→Quiz and Video→Article transitions persist. Article retains only body, Video only URL, Quiz clears both. Existing quiz entity survives type changes; author GET on non-Quiz returns 400, changing back to Quiz restores the exact original definition. Whether retaining the old definition is intended remains unresolved as the catalog requests.

CONTENT-011.assertions: Creator/Admin × Video/Article: title-only PATCH without type preserves body/URL and other omitted fields; same-type PATCH with omitted content clears body/URL and persists the cleared state. Actual frontend PATCH client is executed through a network-free request recorder for both populated/omitted field shapes. It always includes type, preserves present body/URL and JSON-omits undefined content. Inspected editor/autosave copy the full lesson for field edits. This reconciles API/client payload behavior; browser autosave/reload remains separate CONTENT-009/012/014 work.

CONTENT-016.assertions: Creator/Admin × Course/Download: section PATCH/DELETE through another Product return 404. Course lesson creation through mismatched section and lesson PATCH/DELETE through wrong section or Product return 404. Exact both-parent GET snapshots remain unchanged; no cross-parent mutation.

CONTENT-017.assertions: Creator/Admin × Consultation/Membership section POST/PATCH/DELETE return 409; Download lesson POST/PATCH/DELETE return 409. Valid existing unrelated IDs/payloads are supplied, and exact target GET snapshots remain unchanged.

CONTENT-018.assertions: Guest 401, User 403 and nonowner Creator 403 for canonical Course/Download section POST/PATCH/DELETE and Course lesson POST/PATCH/DELETE with valid IDs/payloads/CSRF. Full original snapshots remain unchanged. Creator owner/Admin create, edit and delete new nested Course/Download records; owner is unchanged and deleted rows are absent.

CONTENT-019.assertions: Creator/Admin × Course/Download section methods with unknown/malformed Product or section IDs return 404/400. Course lesson mutations additionally cover missing/malformed Product, section and lesson components. Exact valid Product snapshots remain unchanged after each rejection group.

LEG-001.assertions: Creator/Admin legacy section POST returns 201; shared title/description/position persist. PUT/DELETE return the exact 200 success text, GET verifies each saved/deleted state, and another existing section remains. Forged unrelated userId does not redirect parent ownership; the authenticated actual owner/Admin controls mutation.

LEG-002.assertions: Creator/Admin × Article/Video/Quiz legacy POST returns 201 and applies type-specific body/URL clearing. PUT/DELETE return exact 200 text; IDs, changed fields/position, Product timestamp and GET persistence/removal are verified. Existing unrelated lesson remains. Supplied unrelated userId does not change authorization/ownership.

LEG-003.assertions: All six legacy methods deny Guest/User/nonowner Creator using valid CSRF/payloads and both actual-owner/forged-caller userIds. Creator/Admin independently test every declared required body field missing/blank, unknown/malformed parent or target IDs and missing DELETE query parameters. 400/404 errors preserve the exact control Product. Optional unvalidated fields are not falsely asserted required.
